parameters.name: domainName
parameters.description: Your domain name for the mailbox (e.g. mail.example.com)

parameters.name: hostedZoneId
parameters.description: Route53 hosted zone ID for domainName

parameters.name: adminUsername
parameters.description: Username for the first Cognito admin user

parameters.name: SubdomainNamespace
parameters.description: Optional: place all endpoints under a subdomain namespace (e.g. 'mailbox' → admin.mailbox.example.com). Leave blank to use the root domain.
